# keta

> keta is a finite-element kernel for bar structures and bridges, written in C++20 and driven from Python: a script describes the structure, runs the analyses and processes the results. Install with `pip install keta` (Python 3.10 to 3.13, Linux and Windows wheels); the package has no Python dependency and ships typing stubs. SI units, global Z axis upwards.

The documentation has two parts: the Python API user manual (every command, its parameters and an executed example) and the calculation principles (models, equations and methods). Both exist in English and in French, online and as PDF.
